tier_policy.T0_DIRECT_OFFICIAL: Use only through existing formal authority rules.
tier_policy.T1_EXACT_DERIVED: May be emitted only as a non-authoritative candidate after deterministic validation; formal promotion path is not defined by this contract.
tier_policy.T2_ESTIMATED_DERIVED: Research-only under the current historical-research contract; must retain assumptions, sensitivity and lower confidence; cannot enter formal KPI authority through this prototype.
tier_policy.T3_EXTERNAL_CROSSCHECK: Observation and validation only; cannot overwrite or impersonate T0/T1 and cannot be emitted under the derived-candidate schema.
tier_policy.T4_MODEL_SCENARIO: Forward-looking scenario only; never a historical actual KPI.
tier_policy.DATA_MISSING: Terminal state only after T0, T1, T2 and T3 checks are recorded as exhausted or ineligible.
